# Cloudinary

> Cloudinary is an end-to-end AI-powered media management platform for image and video upload, optimization, storage, transformation, and CDN delivery at scale.

Cloudinary provides a composable, API-first platform combining digital asset management (DAM), intelligent image and video processing, generative AI capabilities, and workflow automation. The platform integrates with major CMS, ecommerce, and cloud platforms including WordPress, Shopify, Contentful, AWS, and others.

## Key Topics

- Image Optimization
- Video Management
- Digital Asset Management (DAM)
- AI Automation
- Generative AI
- Media Management
- Content Delivery Network (CDN)
- API-First Architecture
- Workflow Automation
- Performance Optimization
- Video Transcoding
- User-Generated Content (UGC)
- Headless Architecture
- Asset Transformation
- Cloud Integration

## Core Products

- [Cloudinary Platform Overview](https://cloudinary.com/platform): Platform overview covering image, video, and AI-powered media workflows
- [Cloudinary Image](https://cloudinary.com/products/image): AI optimization, transformation, and CDN delivery for images
- [Cloudinary Video](https://cloudinary.com/products/video): Advanced video solutions including transcoding, smart cropping, and streaming
- [Cloudinary Assets (DAM)](https://cloudinary.com/products/digital_asset_management): Intelligent digital asset management with GenAI for asset organization and discovery
- [Cloudinary AI](https://cloudinary.com/products/cloudinary_ai): GenAI platform for automated image and video processing and generation
- [MediaFlows](https://cloudinary.com/products/mediaflows): No-code/low-code workflow automation for visual media tasks
- [DAM for Video](https://cloudinary.com/products/digital_asset_management/dam-video): AI-powered DAM solution for video asset lifecycle management

## Solutions & Use Cases

- [Composable Architecture](https://cloudinary.com/solutions/composable-architecture): Composable media platform with API-first microservices architecture
- [Headless DAM](https://cloudinary.com/solutions/headless): Headless DAM solution with API-driven content delivery architecture
- [Performance Optimization](https://cloudinary.com/solutions/performance_optimization): Performance optimization with AVIF, JPEG XL, and CDN solutions
- [User-Generated Content Management](https://cloudinary.com/solutions/user-generated-content): UGC management with moderation, optimization, and delivery tools

## Integrations & Partnerships

- [Integrations Overview](https://cloudinary.com/integrations): Cloudinary integrations with CMS, ecommerce, and third-party tools
- [WordPress Plugin](https://cloudinary.com/integrations/wordpress): WordPress plugin for image and video optimization with CDN delivery
- [Shopify Integration](https://cloudinary.com/integrations/shopify): Cloudinary Shopify integration for ecommerce image and video management
- [AWS Partnership](https://cloudinary.com/integrations/aws): Cloudinary AWS partnership for cloud storage and media management
- [Contentful Integration](https://cloudinary.com/integrations/contentful): Contentful CMS integration with Cloudinary for media delivery
- [Syndigo Partnership](https://cloudinary.com/integrations/syndigo): Syndigo PIM and DAM integration for product data management
- [Figma Plugin](https://cloudinary.com/documentation/figma_integration): Figma plugin documentation for asset management and optimization
